title: Agentic coding harness tier list
description: Ranked every agentic coding harness I actually use. OpenClaw drops to D, it breaks every time they ship an update and the codebase is a slop factory. Pi lands in B, rock solid and barely touches memory. Hermes is A, less for session coding and more for running a 24/7 agent in your business. OpenCode is B if you care about open source models and keeping your data off the big AI companies. Claude Code is S, the ecosystem is unbeatable. Codex is S and my personal favorite right now, nothing touches it on the full plan implement review loop. Link in bio.
